sentences.en: The airplane is scheduled to arrive at Honolulu tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 这架飞机计划于明天上午抵达火奴鲁鲁。

sentences.en: The airplane used a rocket motor to assist with takeoff.
sentences.zh: 这架飞机使用火箭发动机辅助起飞。

sentences.en: The natives saw an airplane then for the first time.
sentences.zh: 当地人第一次看到了一架飞机。
